info.title: Spiral Stake — Read API (v1)
info.description: Read-only composition authority for Spiral Stake strategy data. Serves the frozen /strategies contract (agents + app) plus the full app read surface. All numbers are composed from warm cache; a stale/failed upstream serves last-good with a visible stale age.

tags.name: Public
tags.description: Open read endpoints — no key required.

parameters.description: Chain to target — 1 = Ethereum (default), 4663 = Robinhood Chain.

items.description: Frozen /strategies contract (v1). Raw facts; the only verdict is under spiralHints.

pointsIncentive.description: Off-chain points program on the collateral (e.g. Tori Cores). Not a yield. Accrues to the position proxy on the leveraged balance: effective = perDayPerCollateralToken x leverage x tokens.

spiralHints.description: Optional, namespaced Spiral opinion; carries its thresholds.

get.description: The `{ stableApy: [...] }` snapshot the app previously fetched from the dashboard `/apy`. The mcp now owns this data. Not readiness-gated: serves last-good (or an empty list) with a visible stale flag.

get.summary: Full composed Market[] for the v2-client app (raw domain model)
get.description: The internal Market model the app consumes in place of its own client-side composition. Unlike /v1/strategies (curated, string APYs), values keep full precision: BigNumber is tagged as {"$bn":"…"} and bigint as {"$bigint":"…"}; revive both client-side before use.

post.summary: Preview opening a leveraged position (deterministic, no wallet)

payToken.description: Token to pay in. Collateral (direct) or any token (zapped). ETH = zero address.

amount.description: Amount of payToken in human units, e.g. '10000'.

leverage.description: Target leverage (e.g. 3). Provide this OR desiredLtv.

desiredLtv.description: Target LTV percent (e.g. '66.67'). Provide this OR leverage.

503.description: Transient (stale data / no route / RPC) — retry
